title: PSR4: quantum-counted pairs with polynomial classical storage

claims.statement: For PSR4 in the evidence, for every N>=2 and s modulo N, n=ceil(log2 N), the SAME specified finite program (exhaustive n<2^20, signed-object quantum-counted/hash/window pair tree otherwise) has unconditional entire-secret success greater than 2/3 and, on EVERY branch, charged sequential work T=O(n^128 2^((33/32)sqrt(n)sqrt(log2 n))), jointly with all other bounds and clean law. All outside constants are absolute. All source filters, unsuccessful attempts, bounded private preparations, fully expanded predicate gates, addressing, generation and source/work guards are charged. Resource representatives apply for n>=2, with n=1 fixed absolute bounds. Huge disclosed analytic-prefix constants make no practical runtime claim. Its exact numerical growth index is 1/2.

For PSR4 in the evidence, for every N>=2 and s modulo N, n=ceil(log2 N), the SAME specified finite program (exhaustive n<2^20, signed-object quantum-counted/hash/window pair tree otherwise) has unconditional entire-secret success greater than 2/3 and, on EVERY branch, classical storage S_C=O(n^2) bits, jointly with all other bounds and clean law. All outside constants are absolute. All source filters, unsuccessful attempts, bounded private preparations, fully expanded predicate gates, addressing, generation and source/work guards are charged. Resource representatives apply for n>=2, with n=1 fixed absolute bounds. Huge disclosed analytic-prefix constants make no practical runtime claim. Its exact numerical growth index is 0.

For PSR4 in the evidence, for every N>=2 and s modulo N, n=ceil(log2 N), the SAME specified finite program (exhaustive n<2^20, signed-object quantum-counted/hash/window pair tree otherwise) has unconditional entire-secret success greater than 2/3 and, on EVERY branch, quantum storage S_Q=O(n) qubits, jointly with all other bounds and clean law. All outside constants are absolute. All source filters, unsuccessful attempts, bounded private preparations, fully expanded predicate gates, addressing, generation and source/work guards are charged. Resource representatives apply for n>=2, with n=1 fixed absolute bounds. Huge disclosed analytic-prefix constants make no practical runtime claim. Its exact numerical growth index is 0.

For PSR4 in the evidence, for every N>=2 and s modulo N, n=ceil(log2 N), the SAME specified finite program (exhaustive n<2^20, signed-object quantum-counted/hash/window pair tree otherwise) has unconditional entire-secret success greater than 2/3 and, on EVERY branch, acquired source copies Q=O(n^4 2^((33/64)sqrt(n)sqrt(log2 n))), jointly with all other bounds and clean law. All outside constants are absolute. All source filters, unsuccessful attempts, bounded private preparations, fully expanded predicate gates, addressing, generation and source/work guards are charged. Resource representatives apply for n>=2, with n=1 fixed absolute bounds. Huge disclosed analytic-prefix constants make no practical runtime claim. Its exact numerical growth index is 1/2.

For the SAME PSR4 finite program in the evidence, every N>=2 and s, n=ceil(log2 N), with Q the ACTUAL number of acquired source copies including filters and discarded trees, the guaranteed malformed-copy count is tau(n,Q)=0. Every copy must be an independent ideal coset state. Unconditional entire-secret success exceeds 2/3 and all four resource bounds hold jointly on every branch. No positive corruption or maximum-tolerance impossibility is asserted.

structured.error_model: Malformed-sample count among Q acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
